after.zh: 大一点的高斯模糊把噪点和细笔画都糊成一片浅灰，几乎没有坡度；纸边是大块明暗的交界，糊了还是一道坡。看多粗的东西，就先模糊到多粗：这个「尺度」的想法后面会一再出现。扫描 App 找纸张四边，第一步就是这样一条流水线：模糊掉噪声和字，在不制造假边的前提下求梯度，再取阈值。找到的边，后面再拟合成四条直线，就能把斜拍的纸拉正。
after.en: A larger Gaussian blur turns the grain and the thin strokes into a faint grey with almost no slope, while a paper edge, where large areas of light and dark meet, is still a slope after blurring. To look for things of a certain size, blur to that size first: this idea of "scale" will keep coming back. A scanning app finding the four sides of a page starts with exactly this pipeline: blur away the noise and the text, take gradients without inventing edges at the border, then threshold. The edges found are later fitted with four straight lines, so a page photographed at an angle can be straightened.

t.zh: 扫描仪的最后一关：噪声、字、超出范围的纸，全都会遇到。
t.en: The scanner's final level: noise, text and paper running off the scan, all at once.

t.zh: 纸上的字也有边，而且很多：每一笔都是一条暗线，两侧各有一道边。扫描仪要找的却只是纸的四边。
t.en: The text on the paper has edges too, lots of them: every stroke is a dark line with an edge on each side. But the scanner only wants the paper's four sides.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：输出纸张的边，和期望一样。要想的问题：字的笔画和纸边，大小差了多少？
t.en: Your task in this level: output the paper's edges, matching the expected image. Something to think about: how different in size are a stroke of text and a paper edge?

caption.zh: 第一组测试：一页带噪声的字
caption.en: Set 1: a noisy page of text

brief.zh: 真实的扫描件：有噪声，有字，纸常常超出扫描范围。输出纸张的边，和期望一样。
brief.en: Real scans: noisy, with text, and the paper often runs off the edge. Output the paper's edges, as in the expected image.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>各解决了一件事，这次纸上还有字。字的笔画只有一格粗，纸边却是一大片亮挨着一大片暗。
hint.en: <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> each solved one thing, and this time there is text on the paper too. Text strokes are one pixel thick, while a paper edge is a large bright area beside a large dark one.
